docs.title: Advanced Duels
docs.text:
Complete 1v1 and party duel system for Minecraft servers — arenas, kits, betting, queues, ELO ratings, spectating and safe updates.

v5.0 Paper & Spigot 1.21 Java 21 Folia supported

Get Started Commands

docs.title: Everything duels need
docs.text:
• ⚔️

    Duels

    Challenge players in 1v1 or party matches, with requests, countdowns and fair spawns.

    Learn more →

  • 🗺️

    Arenas

    Dedicated arenas with spawn points, kit binding and automatic block regeneration.

    Learn more →

  • 🥇

    ELO & Stats

    Per-kit ratings, leaderboards, killstreaks, wins, losses and player likes.

    Learn more →

  • 👁️

    Spectating

    Watch live matches from a browser GUI, with arena leash and stealth options.

    Learn more →

  • 🎒

    Kits

    Custom kits with Soup, UHC, Combo, Sumo and Best-of-3 modes — or own inventory.

    Learn more →

  • 🔄

    Safe Updates

    Configuration migration with backups — updates never wipe your settings.

    Learn more →

docs.title: Requirements
docs.text:
• A Spigot / Paper server (1.21.x recommended; Folia is supported)
  • Java 21

Optional but recommended: Vault + an economy plugin (for money betting), PlaceholderAPI (for placeholders and scoreboards).

docs.title: Quick installation
docs.text:
1. Drop AdvancedDuels.jar into your server's plugins/ folder.
  2. Restart the server.
  3. Set the duel lobby with /duels setlobby.
  4. Create an arena: /duels create <name>, set both spawn points with /duels set <name> 1 and /duels set <name> 2, enable it with /duels toggle <name>.
  5. Create a kit with /duels savekit <name> (or let players fight with their own inventory).

Read the full walkthrough in First Setup.

docs.title: Where to go next
docs.text:
• New here? Start with Installation, then First Setup.
  • Setting up fights? Creating arenas, Kits, Starting a duel.
  • Running the server? Commands, Permissions, Configuration.
  • Something broken? FAQ and Troubleshooting.
  • Building on top? Developer API.

docs.title: Developer API
docs.text: Advanced Duels exposes a Java API (ad.advancedDuels.api.*) for extensions and integrations.

docs.title: Getting the API
docs.text:
Duels duels = AdvancedDuels.getInstance(); // plugin instance also implements Duels
duels.getVersion();                        // e.g. "5.0"

Core entry points: Duels (scheduler helpers doSync/doAsync*, registerSubCommand, registerListener, reload, teleportToLobby) plus managers: ArenaManager, KitManager, DQueueManager (+ signs), UserManager, SpectateManager, Request.

docs.title: Events
docs.text:
Listen with a normal Bukkit listener:

Event Fired when MatchStartEvent / MatchEndEvent Match begins/ends (MatchEndEvent.Reason: tie, defeat, time, disable...) RequestSendEvent / RequestAcceptEvent / RequestDenyEvent Duel request lifecycle (cancellable) SpectateStartEvent / SpectateEndEvent Spectating begins/ends (start cancellable) ArenaCreateEvent / ArenaRemoveEvent / ArenaSetPositionEvent / ArenaStateChangeEvent Arena lifecycle KitCreateEvent / KitEquipEvent / KitRemoveEvent Kit lifecycle QueueCreateEvent / QueueRemoveEvent / QueueJoinEvent / QueueLeaveEvent Queue lifecycle QueueSignCreateEvent / QueueSignRemoveEvent Queue signs UserCreateEvent First-time userdata creation

docs.title: Custom subcommands
docs.text:
duels.registerSubCommand("duel", mySubCommand); // implements api.command.SubCommand

Names from commands.yml are resolved too (commandKeyMap), and duplicates are rejected with a console warning.

docs.title: Extensions
docs.text: Extend api.extension.DuelsExtension and implement onEnable() / onDisable() for first-class extensions loaded from the plugin's extensions/ folder via its own classloader.

docs.title: Users, matches, spectators
docs.text:
• UserManager: getTopWins/Losses/Ratings, per-user User (wins, losses, killstreaks, likes, ratings, matches).
  • Match: bet, kit, players, items, duration, source queue.
  • SpectateManager.Result: SUCCESS, ALREADY_SPECTATING, IN_QUEUE, IN_MATCH, TARGET_NOT_IN_MATCH, DISABLED, EVENT_CANCELLED.

Scheduler

Always schedule through Duels.doSync*/doAsync* (Folia-aware) instead of Bukkit's scheduler directly — the plugin supports Folia.

docs.title: Where player data lives
docs.text: plugins/AdvancedDuels/users/<uuid>.json — one file per player: wins, losses, killstreaks, likes/dislikes, per-kit ratings, recent matches and rating history. Never hand-edit while the server runs.

docs.title: When it saves
docs.text:
Trigger What happens Player quits Async save (fire-and-forget) Every data.autosave-minutes (default 10) Async save of everyone cached (crash protection; 0 disables) Plugin/server shutdown Synchronous flush of everything cached — shutdowns and restarts never lose stats

Panels that kill the process

A hard kill (kill -9, panel "kill") can only lose progress since the last autosave (≤10 min by default). Clean stops lose nothing.

docs.title: Memory cache
docs.text: Online players plus recent quitters stay cached for speed. Players offline longer than data.cache-minutes (default 30, 0 disables) are saved and dropped from memory, then reloaded transparently on next access — /duel stats <offline>, likes and tops keep working. Name lookups always resolve.

docs.title: Config backups & migration
docs.text: Before any config.yml / commands.yml / language migration, the current file is copied to backups/ (e.g. config-v22-2026-09-26_15-34-43-735.yml). Migration only adds missing keys — your values and custom keys always win. If migration fails, your file is left untouched and the plugin runs with it as-is.

docs.title: Files you should back up externally
docs.text: arenas.json, kits.json, queues.json, signs.json, lobby.json, users/ — these are never touched by updates, but they're also never auto-backed-up. Include them in your regular server backups.

docs.title: How do I create an arena?
docs.text: /duels create <name> → /duels set <name> 1 and 2 at the spawn spots → /duels toggle <name>. Verify with /duels info <name>. Full guide: Arenas.

docs.title: How do I enable arena regeneration?
docs.text: Set arena-regen.block-tracking-enabled: true, restart, take the /duels wand, select two corners and run /duels arenaregen enable <arena>. See Regeneration.

docs.title: How do I enable spectators?
docs.text: Spectating is on by default (spectate.enabled). Players use /duel spectate. Tune the leash (wall-limit), gamemode and invisibility in spectate.*. See Spectating.

docs.title: How do I change messages?
docs.text: Edit plugins/AdvancedDuels/langs/lang_<XX>.yml. Never rename keys or %placeholders%. Switch files with lang: in config.yml. See Languages.

docs.title: How do I change duel settings?
docs.text: Most gameplay tuning is config.yml (reference). Request-GUI options (own inventory, kit/arena pickers, betting) have individual enabled + use-permission switches under request.*.

docs.title: Why isn't a command working?
docs.text:
1. Check the permission (reference) — most admin commands need duels.admin.
  2. Check commands.yml — the command may be renamed on your server.
  3. In a duel/queue/spectate? Command blacklists apply (duel.blacklisted-commands, queue.blacklisted-commands, spectate allowlist).
  4. In a disabled world? Check duel.enabled-worlds / blacklisted-worlds.

docs.title: Why can't players duel?
docs.text: Walk the checklist: free enabled arena with both positions? (/duels list, /duels info) Both players accepting requests (/duel toggle)? No cooldown, right world, cleared inventory if required, not in creative if blocked, not combat-tagged, request not expired (30 s)?

docs.title: Why is money betting rejected?
docs.text: Needs Vault plus an economy provider, request.money-betting.enabled: true, and enough balance on both sides.

docs.title: What permissions do players need?
docs.text: Nothing — duels.default (duel, stats, toggle, top, spectate) is granted to everyone. See Permissions.

docs.title: Stats reset after restart — help!
docs.text: This was a save-path bug fixed by the shutdown flush + autosave: make sure you're on the latest jar. Stats live in users/*.json and flush on quit, every data.autosave-minutes, and fully on shutdown. If files exist but show zeros, check startup errors (Could not load userdata) — a corrupt JSON is skipped, never deleted.

docs.title: My config didn't update!
docs.text: The migrator only adds missing keys — it never rewrites your values. Check config-version at the top and backups/ for what changed. If a file is current but lacks keys, they're healed on next boot automatically.

docs.title: GUIs
docs.text: All GUIs are click-driven; filler materials, rows and most button items are configurable (see Config Reference, guis.*). Message texts live in langs/... under GUI.*.

docs.title: Request settings (/duel <player>)
docs.text: Pick kit, own-inventory mode, arena and item betting, then SEND (green, left) or CANCEL (red, right). Only enabled options appear. Layout: guis.settings.rows, option-button-slots, send-button.*, cancel-button.*, per-button materials.

docs.title: Kit / arena / queue selectors
docs.text:
Paged browsers (/kit... no — opened from request GUI, /queue, or /duels bind):

GUI Opens from Config Kit selector Request GUI kit button guis.kit-selector.rows (1–5) Arena selector Request GUI arena button guis.arena-selector.rows (1–5) Queue browser /queue guis.queues.rows (1–5), inherit-kit-item-type Spectate browser /duel spectate Fixed 4-row layout, live heads

docs.title: Item betting GUI
docs.text: Two-sided: each player fills their 4-wide section and presses READY (their own side only). A 5-step countdown runs once both are ready, then the match starts and items become the bet. Closing early refunds instantly. No config layout (fixed 54-slot design).

docs.title: Bind GUI (/duels bind <kit>)
docs.text: Choose which arenas the kit may run on. Persists per kit.

docs.title: Options GUI (/duels options <kit>)
docs.text: Toggle kit characteristics: Soup, UHC, Combo, Sumo, Hunger, Loka, Best-of-3. See Kits.

docs.title: Kit editor (/kit edit <kit>)
docs.text: Edit kit contents visually; /kit save writes, exiting without saving discards. Aborted automatically if you enter a queue/match mid-edit.

docs.title: Post-match inventories
docs.text: After a match (if display-inventories), clickable names in chat open the fighter's end-of-match inventory (/duel _ <uuid> behind the scenes). View-only, with effects/health/hunger/potion summary buttons.

docs.title: Integrations
docs.text: All integrations are optional soft-depends. A hook is active only when the plugin is installed and you see Successfully hooked into '<name>'! on console. Per-plugin toggles live under supported-plugins.* in config.yml.

docs.title: Economy & betting
docs.text: Vault (+ any Vault economy): enables money betting (/duel <player> <amount>, queue bets). Without an economy provider, money bets are rejected — item betting still works.

docs.title: Anti-combat-log
docs.text: CombatTagPlus / PvPManager / CombatLogX / DeluxeCombat: prevent-duel-if-tagged blocks dueling while tagged; prevent-tag-in-duel keeps duels tag-free.

docs.title: Essentials
docs.text:
• auto-unvanish: unvanish fighters on match start.
  • set-back-location: stops /back from leading into the arena. (Where winners go is still duel.teleport-to-last-location.)

docs.title: Protection & clans
docs.text: Plugin Effect WorldGuard duelzone.enabled + regions: duels only inside listed regions Factions / FactionsUUID No power loss on duel death SimpleClans Duel kills don't touch KDR AxGraves Grave handling inside duels MyPet despawn-pet-in-duel mcMMO disable-skills-in-duel BountyHunters / NotBounties No bounty loss in duels LeaderHeads / MVdWPlaceholderAPI Wins/losses leaderboard menus

docs.title: Placeholders & worlds
docs.text:
• PlaceholderAPI: all %duels_* placeholders (see Placeholders).
  • Multiverse-Core / MyWorlds / MultiWorld: soft-depends so arenas load after world managers (fixes null locations when Duels loads first).

docs.title: Metrics & updates
docs.text:
• bStats: anonymous usage statistics (metrics ID in source). No configuration needed.
  • Update checker: async, notify-only (never downloads). Configure check-for-updates + update-checker.*; in-game notices need duels.update.notify.

docs.title: Permissions
docs.text: duels.* grants everything. Unlisted permissions default to OP-only. Everyone gets duels.default automatically.

docs.title: Default kit (duels.default — all players)
docs.text: Permission Allows duels.duel /duel challenges, accept/deny, lobby, queue-toggle, spectate browser, rematch, like/dislike, forfeit, inventory view, version duels.stats /duel stats (own) duels.toggle /duel toggle duels.top /duel top duels.spectate Spectating (/duel spectate, /duels spectate)

docs.title: Admin (duels.admin — also grants the tree below)
docs.text:
Full /duels access (except /duels spectate, which uses duels.spectate), plus:

Permission Allows duels.update.notify Update notifications on join duels.teleport.bypass Teleport to duelists despite prevent-teleport-to-match-players duels.force --force duels, bypass enabled-world restriction (default: OP) duels.spectate.anonymously Spectate without join/leave announcements duels.kits.* All kits duels.use.* All request-setting options duels.queue Named queues duels.stats.others /duel stats <player> duels.party / duels.party.toggle / duels.party.list.others Party system bits duels.kiteditor /kit edit, /kit save

docs.title: Granular request options
docs.text:
Only enforced when the matching use-permission is true in config.yml:

Permission Gates duels.use.kit-select Kit picker duels.use.own-inventory Own-inventory mode duels.use.arena-select Arena picker duels.use.item-betting Item betting duels.use.money-betting Money betting duels.kits.<kitname> A specific kit (spaces become -, lowercase)

Hiding admin commands

Rename commands or change aliases in commands.yml if they collide with other plugins. All names are lowercased automatically.

docs.title: Placeholders
docs.text: Requires PlaceholderAPI. Prefix: %duels_...%. Every lookup is a cheap map read — safe for scoreboards and tablists that poll constantly.

docs.title: Player stats
docs.text:
Placeholder Example output %duels_wins% 12 %duels_losses% 5 %duels_killstreak% 3 %duels_best_killstreak% 7 %duels_likes% 9 %duels_dislikes% 1 %duels_wl_ratio% / %duels_wlr% 2.4 %duels_average_rating% / %duels_avg_rating% 1452.50 %duels_rating_-% 1400 (own-inventory rating) %duels_rating_<kit>% e.g. %duels_rating_Diamond% %duels_can_request% true %duels_inmatch% true / false (fighting right now) %duels_arena% Colosseum (fighting/spectating arena)

Unknown-data fallbacks come from the bottom of config.yml (user-not-found, not-in-match, no-kit, no-opponent).

docs.title: Queues
docs.text:
Placeholder Example output %duels_isinqueue_<queue>% Yes / No %duels_getplayersinqueue_<queue>% 3 %duels_getplayersplayinginqueue_<queue>% 2

<queue> is the queue name (kit+bet fallback parsing supported).

docs.title: Current match (fighter or spectator)
docs.text: Placeholder Example output %duels_match_duration% 01:23 %duels_match_kit% Diamond %duels_match_arena% Colosseum %duels_match_bet% 100 %duels_match_rating% Your rating for this kit %duels_match_opponent% Steve %duels_match_opponent_health% 7.0 (hearts) %duels_match_opponent_ping% 42 %duels_match_opponent_rating% 1510

docs.title: Queue & Signs
docs.text: Queues are automated matchmaking: join, get paired with a similarly-rated opponent, fight. Two systems exist side by side.

docs.title: Named queues (admin-created)
docs.text:
/duels createqueue <name> <bet> <team-size> [<kit>|-]
/duels deletequeue <bet> [<kit>|-]      # aliases: delqueue, delq
  • <kit> = kit name, - = own inventory.
  • Players join via the queue GUI (/queue), /queue join <name> (alias j), or a sign. Leave with /queue leave (alias l).
  • Blocked commands while queued: queue.blacklisted-commands.
  • Money bet is taken on join; joining without funds is rejected.

docs.title: Queue signs
docs.text:
Stand looking at a wall sign and run:

/duels addsign <queueName> <bet> <team-size> [<kit>|-]
/duels delsign      # while looking at the sign (alias: delsign handled via delsign)

Signs show queue name, bet, players waiting/in-match, and update live. Delete with /duels delsign while looking at it. Breaking a queue sign by hand is blocked — remove it with the command.

docs.title: Simple queue (quick matchmaking)
docs.text:
/duel queue

Toggles a no-setup 1v1 queue using own inventory. First two waiting players are matched instantly. Messages: QUEUE.simple-add, simple-remove, simple-found.

docs.title: Matchmaking rules
docs.text:
• Opponents pair within rating.max-difference (default 400 ELO).
  • Queue matches can exclusively change ratings (rating.queue-matches-only).
  • Start/end/win/lose commands can be scoped to queue matches (queue-matches-only per group).
  • Queues need a free compatible arena like any duel.

docs.title: Spectating
docs.text: Watch live duels without interfering. Requires duels.spectate (granted to everyone by default).

docs.title: How to spectate
docs.text:
/duel spectate              # open the live-match browser
/duel spectate <player>     # spectate that player's match directly
/duels spectate [player]    # same, under the admin command

Click a head in the browser to jump in. Run the command again (no args) to stop. Fighters see X is now spectating the match! and X stopped spectating. — unless you have duels.spectate.anonymously, which hides both messages.

docs.title: What spectators experience
docs.text:
• Teleported above the target; adventure mode + flight (or vanilla spectator mode with use-spectator-gamemode), invisibility effect unless disabled, non-colliding.
  • Most commands blocked (allowlist: spectate.whitelisted-commands); teleports and interaction cancelled; can't damage or be damaged; can't pick up items.
  • Leaving the arena area teleports you back (wall limit, see below).
  • When the match ends you're notified and returned to your pre-spectate state.

docs.title: Configuration (spectate.*)
docs.text: Option Default Effect enabled true Master switch for all spectating wall-limit.enabled / .radius true / 25.0 Leash around the arena center; cross it and you're pulled back with a message requires-cleared-inventory false Empty inventory required use-spectator-gamemode false True vanilla spectator mode instead of adventure+flight add-invisibility-effect true Invisibility (ignored in spectator gamemode) whitelisted-commands msg-like list Commands usable while spectating

docs.title: Troubleshooting
docs.text: Each entry: Problem → Likely cause → Fix.

docs.title: "No arena available" when dueling
docs.text: → Arena missing, disabled, or without both positions. → /duels list (green = usable), then create/set/toggle as needed. Also check kit↔arena bindings (/duels bind) — a kit bound to zero usable arenas never starts.

docs.title: Requests instantly expire / accept does nothing
docs.text: → Cooldown active, player moved with cancel-if-moved: true, or acceptor in a disabled world. → Check duel.cooldown, stand still, accept in an enabled world.

docs.title: Winner goes to spawn instead of pre-duel spot
docs.text: → That's duel.teleport-to-last-location: false (lobby return). → Set it true for last-location returns. (Essentials set-back-location only controls /back, not the duel return itself.)

docs.title: /back leads into the arena
docs.text: → Essentials hook inactive. → Install Essentials and keep supported-plugins.Essentials.set-back-location: true; confirm the hook message on console.

docs.title: Kit items work outside duels
docs.text: → duel.protect-kit-items is false. → Enable it (tags stay attached even while toggled off, so re-enabling is safe).

docs.title: Teleporting (pearls, abilities) behaves oddly in duels
docs.text: → duel.limit-teleportation (ender pearls are always exempt). → Raise distance-allowed if players get stuck, or disable the limiter.

docs.title: Queue never pops
docs.text: → Rating gap above rating.max-difference, no free compatible arena, or bet mismatch. → Widen the gap, check arenas, align bets/kits.

docs.title: Signs don't update / can't be broken
docs.text: → Signs refresh on a timer; hand-breaking queue signs is blocked by design. → /duels delsign while looking at the sign.

docs.title: Spectator stuck / can't leave area
docs.text: → Wall limit (spectate.wall-limit) pulls leavers back — intended. → Run the spectate command again to stop, or disable/raise the limit.

docs.title: Failed to load message in console
docs.text: → A lang key or %placeholder% was renamed or deleted in langs/. → Restore the key from the jar defaults (compare with a fresh file); never rename keys.

docs.title: Could not load userdata ... on boot
docs.text: → A users/<uuid>.json is corrupt. → The file is skipped (not deleted). Restore it from your server backups, or delete it to start that player fresh.

docs.title: Update notice shows null download link
docs.text: → update-checker.download-url is empty. → Set it to your download page, or check-for-updates: false to silence checking.

docs.title: Lag during big fights
docs.text: → The plugin's hot paths are map lookups and guarded listeners; heavy cost usually comes from elsewhere (scoreboards polling placeholders are fine — they're O(1)). → Profile with Spark; common real causes are oversized arenas with block-tracking on TNT-heavy kits.

docs.title: Creating & Managing Arenas
docs.text: Arenas are the stages duels are fought in. A match needs a free arena with two spawn points set and the arena enabled — otherwise requests fail with "no arena available".

docs.title: Creating an arena
docs.text:
/duels create <name>
/duels set <name> 1
/duels set <name> 2
/duels toggle <name>
  1. /duels create Colosseum — creates a disabled arena.
  2. Stand where fighter 1 should spawn → /duels set Colosseum 1.
  3. Stand where fighter 2 should spawn → /duels set Colosseum 2.
  4. /duels toggle Colosseum — enables it so matches can use it.

Spawn placement

Face the spawns toward each other and keep ~15–30 blocks distance. The pre-match countdown freezes movement, so players get a fair look at the arena before GO!.

docs.title: Managing arenas
docs.text:
Command What it does /duels list Lists all arenas (color-coded: red = disabled, blue = no positions, green = available, dark red = in use) plus kits, queues, signs and lobby status /duels info <arena> Shows state, positions, bound kits and settings /duels toggle <arena> Enable/disable (flips current state) /duels enable <arena> / /duels disable <arena> Explicit on/off /duels teleport <arena> [1\|2] Teleport yourself to a spawn point (aliases: tp, goto) /duels delete <arena> Deletes an arena (must not be in use — disable it first) /duels setgroup <arena> <group> Group arenas for the selector GUI /duels setarenaitem <arena> Sets the GUI display item to the item in your hand

All need duels.admin.

docs.title: Kit binding & display
docs.text:
• /duels bind <kit> — opens the arena-bind GUI: choose on which arenas a kit may be used. Bound kits ignore random arenas they don't fit.
  • /duels setarenaitem <arena> — hold an item, run the command: that item represents the arena in selector GUIs.

docs.title: Spawn points
docs.text: Stored per arena (arenas.json, managed in-game — don't hand-edit). Both positions must be set or the arena counts as unavailable. Re-running /duels set <arena> 1|2 moves a spawn.

docs.title: Spectator-relevant notes
docs.text: Spectators are leashed around the arena center (spectate.wall-limit.radius, default 25 blocks) — build spectator-freedom-friendly arenas or raise the radius for huge maps. See Spectating.

docs.title: Next
docs.text:
• Destructible arenas? Regeneration.
  • Matchmaking signs for arenas? Queue & Signs.

docs.title: Arena Regeneration
docs.text: Regeneration restores blocks that were broken, placed or exploded inside an arena while a duel was running — so the next match starts on a pristine map. No WorldEdit needed: the plugin records changes with Bukkit events and rolls them back when the match ends.

docs.title: How it works
docs.text:
1. Before a match, tracking starts for that arena if it has bounds set and block tracking is enabled.
  2. Every block break/place/explosion inside the bounds is recorded (original state only — lightweight).
  3. When the match ends, recorded blocks are restored.

Bounds are required

If an arena has no bounds, tracking is skipped with a console warning telling you to run /duels arenaregen enable <arena>. Setting block-tracking-enabled: true alone is not enough.

docs.title: Setup
docs.text:
# 1. Enable tracking globally
arena-regen.block-tracking-enabled: true     # in config.yml, then restart or /duels reload

# 2. In game: get the selection wand
/duels wand

# 3. Select two corners (left/right click), then bind them to the arena
/duels arenaregen enable <arena>

Useful extras:

Command What it does /duels arenaregen status [arena] Show whether bounds exist and tracking state /duels arenaregen disable <arena> Remove an arena's bounds (tracking stops for it) /duels arenaregen onlyarena Scope the current selection to one arena (see usage text in game) /duels regen status Global regen system status

Aliases: aregen, regenbounds for arenaregen; tracker, blocktrack for regen.

docs.title: Configuration
docs.text:
arena-regen:
  block-tracking-enabled: false   # default: off

docs.title: Limitations
docs.text:
• Only changes inside the bounds are tracked — build bounds generously around the playable area.
  • Only block break/place/explosion events are recorded (custom plugin shenanigans outside Bukkit events are not).
  • Very block-heavy modes (TNT spam) record more data, but only original states — one entry per changed block.

docs.title: Admin Commands (/duels)
docs.text: Base permission: duels.admin (console-safe unless noted). Aliases: ds. Subcommand help is grouped: /duels help <arena|kit|queue|sign|user|extra|arenaregen>.

docs.title: Arenas
docs.text: Command Description /duels create <name> Create a disabled arena /duels set <name> <1\|2> Set spawn point 1/2 at your location (player-only) /duels toggle <name> Enable/disable (flip) /duels enable <name> / /duels disable <name> Explicit on/off /duels teleport <name> [1\|2] (aliases tp, goto) Teleport to a spawn (player-only) /duels info <name> State, positions, bound kits /duels list (alias ls) Arenas, kits, queues, signs, lobby status (color-coded) /duels delete <name> Delete an unused arena (disable first) /duels setgroup <arena> <group> (alias group) GUI grouping /duels setarenaitem <arena> GUI icon = held item (player-only) /duels bind <kit> Arena-binding GUI for a kit (player-only) /duels wand (alias selectionwand) Arena selection wand (player-only)

docs.title: Arena regeneration
docs.text:
Command Description /duels arenaregen <enable\|disable\|status> [arena] (aliases aregen, regenbounds) Set/check per-arena regen bounds using the wand selection /duels regen <status> (aliases tracker, blocktrack) Global regen system status

See Regeneration.

docs.title: Kits
docs.text: Command Description /duels savekit <name> Save your inventory as a kit (player-only) /duels loadkit <name> Load a kit into your inventory (player-only) /duels deletekit <name> Delete a kit /duels setitem <kit> GUI icon = held item (player-only) /duels options <kit> (alias useoption) Kit characteristics GUI — Soup, UHC, Combo, Sumo, Hunger, Loka, Best-of-3 (player-only)

docs.title: Queues & signs
docs.text: Command Description /duels createqueue <name> <bet> <size> [<kit>\|-] (alias createq) Create a queue /duels deletequeue <bet> [<kit>\|-] (aliases delqueue, delq) Delete a queue /duels addsign <queue> <bet> <size> [<kit>\|-] Turn the looked-at sign into a queue sign (player-only) /duels delsign Remove the looked-at queue sign (player-only)

docs.title: Players & stats
docs.text: Command Description /duels edit <player> <add\|remove\|set> <wins\|losses> <amount> Correct win/loss records /duels reset <player> Wipe all stats (wins, losses, streaks, likes, ratings, matches) /duels setrating <player> <-|kit> <amount> Set a rating (- = own-inventory) /duels resetrating <player> <-|kit|all> (alias resetr) Reset ratings

docs.title: Lobby & misc
docs.text: Command Description /duels setlobby (alias setspawn) Duel return lobby = your spot (player-only) /duels setkitlobby Kit-editor lobby = your spot (player-only) /duels lobby Teleport to the lobby (player-only) /duels spectate [player] Spectate (player permission duels.spectate, not admin) /duels playsound <name> Preview a configured sounds.* entry (player-only) /duels reload (alias rl) Reload configs /duels about Plugin info /duels help [category] (alias h) Categorized help

docs.title: Player Commands
docs.text: All commands and aliases can be renamed in commands.yml. Default permissions: everyone gets duel, stats, toggle, top and spectate (via duels.default); everything else needs OP or an explicit grant.

docs.title: /duel
docs.text:
Base permission: duels.duel (everyone). All subcommands are player-only.

Command Description /duel <player> Open the request settings GUI for a duel /duel <player> <bet> [true] [kit\|-] Send a configured request immediately (bet = Vault money, true = item betting, kit name or - for own inventory) /duel <player> ... --force Start immediately without accept (needs duels.force; no item betting) /duel accept <player> Accept a request (opens item-bet GUI if enabled) /duel deny <player> Decline a request /duel stats [player] Stats, ratings, killstreak, likes, past matches (others need duels.stats.others) /duel top [-|wins|losses|killstreak|kit] Leaderboards (- = own-inventory rating). Needs duels.top /duel toggle Stop/allow receiving duel requests. Needs duels.toggle /duel lobby Teleport to the duel lobby /duel queue Toggle the quick-match simple queue /duel spectate [player] Open the live-match browser, or spectate directly. Needs duels.spectate /duel rematch [player] Re-send the last match's settings (1v1 offers, 5-min expiry) /duel like <player> / /duel dislike <player> Rate a recent opponent (30-min window, one per match) /duel forfeit Leave the current match as a loss /duel _ <uuid> Open a post-match inventory preview (used via clickable chat message, not typed) /duel version (alias v) Plugin version

Requests expire after request.expiration seconds and are validated on accept (world, cooldown, inventory, cooldown, combat-tag...).

docs.title: /party (alias p, duelparty, dp)
docs.text:
Base permission: duels.party. Bare /party <player> sends an invite.

Command Permission Description /party <player> duels.party Invite (creates the party, you own it) /party accept <player> (alias a) duels.party Accept an invite /party leave (alias l) duels.party Leave (owner must transfer/disband instead) /party kick <player> (alias remove) duels.party Owner kicks a member /party transfer <player> duels.party Pass ownership /party disband duels.party Owner disbands /party list (alias ls) duels.party List members /party toggle duels.party.toggle Block party invites /party friendlyfire (alias ff) duels.party Allow hitting party members

docs.title: /queue (alias q)
docs.text:
Base permission: duels.queue.

Command Description /queue Open the queue browser GUI /queue join <name> (alias j) Join a queue (money bet taken on join) /queue leave (alias l) Leave the queue

docs.title: /kit
docs.text: Command Permission Description /kit edit <kit> duels.kiteditor Visual kit editor (save with /kit save) /kit save duels.kiteditor Save + exit the editor

docs.title: /duels spectate [player]
docs.text: Needs duels.spectate (NOT duels.admin — the subcommand carries its own permission). Same behavior as /duel spectate: browser GUI without args, direct spectate with a name, toggle-off when already spectating.

docs.title: Configuration Overview
docs.text: Advanced Duels stores its configuration in plugins/AdvancedDuels/. There is no messages.yml — messages live in the langs/ folder instead.

docs.title: Files
docs.text: File What it controls Migrated on update? config.yml Everything gameplay-related (duels, betting, queues, rating, spectating, GUIs...) Yes, with backup commands.yml Command names and aliases (duel, party, queue, duels, kit) Yes, with backup langs/lang_XX.yml All chat messages, GUI texts and usages (7 languages included) Yes — missing keys merged in arenas.json, kits.json, queues.json, signs.json Your arenas, kits, queues, signs (managed in-game, don't hand-edit) Never touched users/*.json Per-player stats, ratings, likes, match history Never touched lobby.json, kit_lobby.json Duel lobby positions Never touched backups/ Timestamped copies made before any migration —

docs.title: Safe updates
docs.text:
Updating never overwrites your settings:

  1. On boot the plugin compares each file's config-version with the version shipped in the jar.
  2. If yours is older, the current file is copied to backups/ (e.g. backups/config-v22-2026-09-26_15-34-43-735.yml).
  3. New default keys are added; your existing values always win; unknown/custom keys are preserved.
  4. If a file is already current but still misses keys (e.g. after a manual edit), the missing keys are healed the same way.

If migration ever fails, the original file is left untouched and the plugin continues with it — it never replaces your config with defaults. Details: Data & Backups.

Reloading config

/duels reload reloads configuration without a restart. Prefer a full restart after updating the jar itself.

docs.title: Where things live
docs.text:
• Gameplay tuning → config.yml reference
  • Renaming /duel etc. → commands.yml (commands.<name>.name + aliases, all lowercased automatically)
  • Any text players see → langs/ language files
  • PlaceholderAPI fallback texts (user-not-found, not-in-match, ...) → bottom of config.yml

docs.title: MiniMessage or legacy colors?
docs.text: use-minimessages: false by default — messages use classic & color codes. Set it to true to parse messages as MiniMessage instead (e.g. <red>text</red>, gradients). There is also a lang_minimessages.yml resource with MiniMessage-styled defaults for reference.

docs.title: config.yml Reference
docs.text: Complete reference for every option (current config-version: 25). New keys merge in automatically on update — your values are never overwritten (see Configuration Overview).

NONE = no checking. docs.title: Messages & Languages
docs.text: All player-facing text lives in plugins/AdvancedDuels/langs/. There is no messages.yml.

docs.title: Selecting a language
docs.text:
lang: lang_EN

Available files: lang_EN, lang_DE, lang_ES, lang_FR, lang_PL, lang_RU, lang_CZ. Restart (or /duels reload) after changing.

If your selected file is outdated compared to the jar, the console warns you — and any keys you are missing are merged in automatically with a backup, so updating never deletes your edits.

docs.title: Editing messages
docs.text:
• Open plugins/AdvancedDuels/langs/lang_<XX>.yml and edit values. Keys must stay exactly as they are.
  • Placeholders like %player%, %kit%, %arena%, %bet_amount% are replaced at runtime — never delete or rename them.
  • {PREFIX} is defined once at the top under STRINGS: and reused everywhere. Change it in one place to rebrand every message.
  • Colors use & codes by default. Set use-minimessages: true in config.yml to use MiniMessage formatting instead.

Never rename keys or placeholders

Renaming a key (e.g. spectate: → watch:) or a placeholder (e.g. %kit% → %set%) silently breaks that message — the plugin logs Failed to load message and sends nothing for it.

docs.title: Adding a new language
docs.text:
1. Copy langs/lang_EN.yml to langs/lang_MY.yml.
  2. Translate the values only.
  3. Set lang: lang_MY in config.yml and restart.

docs.title: MiniMessage
docs.text: With use-minimessages: true, messages support MiniMessage tags (<red>, <bold>, gradients, ...). The lang_minimessages.yml file shipped in the jar shows the same messages in MiniMessage style as a reference.

docs.title: PlaceholderAPI fallback texts
docs.text:
These five small texts at the bottom of config.yml are used when data is unavailable:

Key Shown when user-not-found Placeholder requested for a player with no loaded data not-in-match Placeholder needs a match but the player has none (none) duration-format Match duration format (mm:ss) no-kit Duel uses own inventory instead of a kit (none) no-opponent Opponent placeholder with no opponent (No opponent)

docs.title: Challenge someone
docs.text:
/duel <player>
/duel <player> <money-bet> [true] [kit|-]
  • /duel Steve — opens the request settings GUI for a plain duel.
  • /duel Steve 100 — same, with a $100 money bet (needs Vault + enabled money betting).
  • /duel Steve 100 true — additionally opens item betting after accept.
  • /duel Steve 100 true Diamond — skips the GUI and sends the request immediately with kit Diamond.
  • Use - instead of a kit name for own-inventory mode: /duel Steve 0 false -.
  • Add --force (needs duels.force) to start immediately without accept, e.g. for events: /duel Steve Diamond --force. Forced duels cannot use item betting.

docs.title: The request settings GUI
docs.text:
Opens automatically unless all settings were given via command. From left to right:

Button What it does Permission / config Kit selector Pick the kit (Random if none) request.kit-selecting.*, duels.use.kit-select Own inventory Fight with your gear instead of a kit request.use-own-inventory.*, duels.use.own-inventory Arena selector Pick the arena (Random if none) request.arena-selecting.*, duels.use.arena-select Item betting Toggle the item-bet GUI step request.item-betting.*, duels.use.item-betting Request details Summary of the current setup — SEND (green) / CANCEL (red) Send or discard the request —

Option button slots, rows and materials are configurable under guis.settings.*.

docs.title: Requirements to duel
docs.text:
Both players must: be online and visible, not be in a match/queue/spectating, have no duel cooldown active, accept requests (/duel toggle), and be in allowed worlds/regions (see duel.enabled-worlds, blacklisted-worlds, WorldGuard duelzone). Depending on config: cleared inventory, no creative mode, not combat-tagged, potion/kit rules.

Use /duel toggle to stop receiving requests at all.

docs.title: After the fight
docs.text:
• Winner is teleported after teleport-delay seconds — to the lobby, or back to their pre-duel spot with teleport-to-last-location: true.
  • Both sides get a clickable [REMATCH] offer (same settings, expires per duel.match.rematch.expire-after, 1v1 only).
  • /duel forfeit leaves a running match as a loss (disable with duel.forfeit.enabled).
  • /duel like <player> / /duel dislike <player> rates a recent opponent (30-minute window by default).

docs.title: Betting
docs.text: Two independent systems: money bets (Vault) and item bets (secure GUI). Both are optional per duel and can be disabled globally. Party duels never support betting.

docs.title: Money betting
docs.text:
/duel Steve 100
  • Requires Vault + an economy plugin, and request.money-betting.enabled: true.
  • The amount is taken from both players at match start; the winner receives double.
  • With use-permission: true, players need duels.use.money-betting.
  • Without Vault/economy, money bets are rejected with "Money betting is currently disabled."
  • Queues can also carry a money bet (set at queue creation).

docs.title: Item betting
docs.text:
1. Enable Item Betting in the request GUI (or /duel <player> <bet> true ...).
  2. After accept, both players put items into the shared GUI and press READY.
  3. The match starts only when both are ready. Closing early refunds instantly.
  4. The winner receives all bet items after the match.

Anti-dupe design: items enter a bet only on mutual confirm, GUI close = instant refund, and bets re-validate at match start.

docs.title: World restriction
docs.text:
request:
  item-betting:
    allowed-worlds: []   # empty = everywhere; e.g. "Duels, world"

Use this to stop value moving between worlds via bets (e.g. creative/give worlds vs. survival). Bypasses: OPs. Denied attempts show "Item betting is not allowed in this world."

docs.title: Disabling betting
docs.text:
• request.item-betting.enabled: false → toggle disappears from the GUI.
  • request.money-betting.enabled: false → money amounts are rejected.
  • Granular permissions (duels.use.item-betting, duels.use.money-betting, duels.use.*) when the matching use-permission is on.

docs.title: Countdown
docs.text: When countdown.enabled is true, fighters are teleported to the arena spawns and a countdown runs (length = number of countdown.duel.messages). During it, movement, projectiles, PvP and interaction can each be frozen (countdown.prevent.*). Titles (5…4…3…2…1…GO!) and sounds play per message.

docs.title: During the fight
docs.text:
• Kits are equipped (or own inventory kept), pets removed, mcMMO skills off (per config), vanished players unvanished (Essentials).
  • Protections apply per config: inventory open, item drop/pickup, command black/whitelists, teleport distance, kit-item NBT tagging.
  • Timed matches (duel.match.max-duration, default 3 min) show a configurable boss bar in the last 2 minutes and end in a tie at zero.
  • Leaving the server mid-duel counts as a death (and a loss).

docs.title: Winning, losing, tying
docs.text:
• Death ends 1v1 duels: winner/loser records, ratings, bets and items resolve; the winner teleports out after teleport-delay.
  • Team/party duels: deaths become arena spectators; when one side is wiped, the match ends.
  • Tie (timer, mutual end, plugin disable): money bets are refunded, no winner commands run.
  • Forfeit (/duel forfeit): immediate loss with full consequences; disabled via duel.forfeit.enabled.
  • End messages go server-wide unless arena-only-end-message is true. A firework spawns unless spawn-firework is off. Post-match inventories are viewable via the clickable message (/duel inventory <uuid>).

docs.title: Rewards & automation
docs.text:
Console commands can run at match start/end and separately for winner/loser:

duel:
  match:
    start-commands: { enabled: false, commands: ['broadcast %player% is entering a duel!'] }
    end-commands:   { enabled: false, commands: ['give %winner% diamond 1'] }
    win-commands:   { enabled: false, commands: ['say %winner% won against %loser%!'] }
    lose-commands:  { enabled: false, commands: ['say %loser% lost against %winner%!'] }

Placeholders: %player% (start), %winner%, %loser%, %kit%, %arena%, %bet_amount% (end/win/lose). Append {delay:ms} to any command to delay it, e.g. say GG!{delay:5000}. Each group can be limited to queue matches with queue-matches-only.

docs.title: Cooldowns & return location
docs.text:
• duel.cooldown (seconds, default 0 = off) blocks instant re-dueling.
  • Winners return to the lobby (/duels setlobby) unless teleport-to-last-location: true sends them back to their pre-duel spot.
  • Essentials set-back-location: true keeps /back from pointing into the arena.

docs.title: Party Duels
docs.text: Parties let groups fight as teams. Only equally-sized parties can duel each other by default (party.same-size-only: true).

docs.title: Party basics
docs.text:
Command What it does /party <player> Invite a player (creates the party, you become owner) /party accept <player> Accept an invite /party leave Leave (owner must transfer first or disband) /party kick <player> Owner kicks a member /party transfer <player> Pass ownership /party disband Owner disbands /party list Show members /party toggle Block party invites /party friendlyfire Allow party members to hit each other (alias ff)

Relevant permissions: duels.party, duels.party.toggle, duels.party.list.others.

docs.title: Starting a party duel
docs.text:
Challenge while in a party: /duel <player> (target's party is picked up automatically). The party leaders get the accept flow; on accept the whole teams are teleported in.

Limitations:

  • No money or item betting in party duels.
  • All members share kit/arena choice from the request.

docs.title: During the match
docs.text: Dead teammates stay in the arena as spectators. Elimination messages show if duel.elimination-feed is on. When one team is wiped, ratings/wins resolve per team and everyone is teleported out after teleport-delay.

docs.title: Configuration
docs.text:
party:
  invite-expiration: 30     # invite expiry (seconds)
  auto-disband-after: 10    # disband when owner offline N minutes (-1 = never)
  max-size: 10
  same-size-only: true

docs.title: ELO rating
docs.text:
Each kit (plus own-inventory mode) has its own rating, starting at rating.default-rating (1400). Wins move points from loser to winner scaled by rating.k-factor (32).

/duel stats [player]     # your stats, ratings, killstreak, likes, past matches
/duel top [wins|losses|killstreak|kit|-]
  • rating.queue-matches-only: true limits rating changes to queue matches.
  • Queue matchmaking pairs players within rating.max-difference (400).
  • Admins: /duels setrating <player> <-|kit> <amount>, /duels resetrating <player> <-|kit|all>.

docs.title: Leaderboards
docs.text: /duel top categories: - (own-inventory rating), wins, losses, killstreak, or a kit name for its rating board. Boards refresh every top.update-interval minutes (default 5); titles come from top.displayed-replacers.*.

docs.title: Killstreaks
docs.text: Kills in duels raise your streak; dying (or forfeiting) resets it. Best streak is kept forever. Shown in /duel stats, ranked in /duel top killstreak, and available as %duels_killstreak% / %duels_best_killstreak% placeholders.

docs.title: Likes & dislikes
docs.text:
After a match, opponents can rate each other:

/duel like <player>
/duel dislike <player>

Rules (likes.*): only opponents from a match that ended within window-minutes (default 30), one rating per player per match, no self-rating, toggleable via likes.enabled. Totals show in /duel stats (%duels_likes%, %duels_dislikes%). Designed as a lightweight sportsmanship signal.

docs.title: Rematch
docs.text: After 1v1 duels both sides get a clickable [REMATCH] that re-sends the same settings (kit, arena, bets re-validated). Offers expire after duel.match.rematch.expire-after (300 s), or type /duel rematch [player] manually. No offers for party, forced or tied matches.

docs.title: How requests work
docs.text:
1. The challenger configures the duel (GUI or command args) and sends the request.
  2. The target gets a message with clickable [ACCEPT] / [DENY].
  3. On accept with item betting enabled, both players place items into the shared betting GUI and confirm — only then does the match start.
  4. Otherwise the match starts immediately (after the countdown, if enabled).
/duel accept <player>
/duel deny <player>

Requests expire after request.expiration seconds (default 30). Accepting in a disallowed world is rejected.

docs.title: Opting out
docs.text: /duel toggle flips whether you accept duel requests (duels.toggle, default: on for everyone). Party invites have their own toggle: /party toggle (duels.party.toggle).

docs.title: For admins
docs.text:
• /duels edit <player> <add|remove|set> <wins|losses> <amount> — correct a player's record.
  • /duels reset <player> — wipe a player's full stats (wins, losses, streaks, likes, ratings, matches).
  • /duels resetrating <player> <-|kit|all> — reset ratings only.
  • /duels setrating <player> <-|kit> <amount> — set a rating directly.

docs.title: First Setup
docs.text: Five-minute path from fresh install to your first duel. All commands below need the duels.admin permission (or OP).

docs.title: 1. Set the duel lobby
docs.text:
Stand where players should return after a duel and run:

/duels setlobby

This saves the lobby to lobby.json. (There is also a separate kit-editing lobby: /duels setkitlobby.)

docs.title: 2. Create your first arena
docs.text:
/duels create Colosseum

Then stand on spawn point 1 and run /duels set Colosseum 1, stand on spawn point 2 and run /duels set Colosseum 2.

/duels set Colosseum 1
/duels set Colosseum 2

Check it with /duels info Colosseum, then enable it:

/duels toggle Colosseum

A disabled arena is never picked for matches. Full details: Creating & Managing Arenas.

docs.title: 3. Create your first kit (optional)
docs.text:
Put the gear you want into your own inventory, then:

/duels savekit Diamond

Players can also duel with their own inventory without any kit — see Kits and kit characteristics like Soup, UHC or Best-of-3.

docs.title: 4. Fight!
docs.text:
As a regular player:

/duel Steve

Accept with /duel accept Steve, fight, and the winner is teleported back while stats, ratings and bets resolve automatically.

/duel accept Steve
/duel deny Steve

docs.title: Common first-time gotchas
docs.text:
• "No arena available" — you created an arena but forgot /duels toggle <name>, or the arena has no positions set. Check /duels info <name>.
  • Duels don't start in your world — duel.enabled-worlds restricts dueling worlds (empty = everywhere). See Configuration.
  • Money bet says disabled — install Vault + an economy plugin, or leave betting to items.
  • Messages look wrong — pick your language with lang: in config.yml (lang_EN, lang_DE, lang_ES, lang_FR, lang_PL, lang_RU, lang_CZ), then restart.

Next: Starting a Duel for everything players can do, or the full Config Reference.

docs.title: Requirements
docs.text:
Requirement Details Server software Spigot or Paper, Minecraft 1.21.x recommended (Folia is supported) Java Java 21 Disk space A few MB for configs, kits, arenas and per-player data files

Paper recommended

Advanced Duels runs on both Spigot and Paper, but Paper (or a Paper fork) is recommended for performance and Folia compatibility.

docs.title: Optional dependencies
docs.text:
These plugins unlock extra features when installed. Everything is a soft dependency — the plugin works fine without them.

Plugin Unlocks Vault + economy plugin Money betting (/duel <player> <amount>) PlaceholderAPI All %duels_* placeholders (see Placeholders) Essentials Anti-vanish on duel start, /back protection in arenas WorldGuard Duel-only regions (duelzone) CombatTagPlus / PvPManager / CombatLogX / DeluxeCombat Block duels while combat-tagged, no tagging inside duels mcMMO Disable skills inside duels MyPet Despawn pets on duel start Factions / FactionsUUID No power loss on duel death SimpleClans Keep KDR unchanged by duels BountyHunters / NotBounties No bounty loss on duel death LeaderHeads / MVdWPlaceholderAPI Leaderboard integrations Multiverse-Core / MyWorlds / MultiWorld Better loading order for arenas in managed worlds AxGraves Grave handling in duels

See Integrations for per-plugin settings.

docs.title: Installing
docs.text:
1. Download AdvancedDuels.jar.
  2. Place it in your server's plugins/ directory.
  3. Restart the server (a full restart, not /reload — especially when updating).
  4. Check the console for Successfully enabled AdvancedDuels. If you see hook messages like Successfully hooked into 'Vault'!, those integrations are active.

docs.title: Files created
docs.text:
On first start the plugin creates (inside plugins/AdvancedDuels/):

File / folder Purpose config.yml Main configuration commands.yml Command names and aliases langs/ Message files (lang_EN.yml, lang_DE.yml, …) users/ One JSON file per player (stats, ratings, likes) arenas.json, kits.json, queues.json, signs.json Your arenas, kits, queues and signs lobby.json, kit_lobby.json Duel lobby positions backups/ Automatic backups before every config migration logs/ Plugin log files

Updating? Don't use /reload

Always do a full server restart when updating the jar. Reloading can leave stale classes in memory. Your settings are safe: updates migrate config.yml automatically with a backup (see Data & Backups).

docs.title: Next step
docs.text: Continue with First Setup — lobby, first arena and first kit in about five minutes.

docs.title: Kits
docs.text: Kits are predefined inventories (armor, weapons, potions, food) that fighters are equipped with. Alternatively, duels can be fought with each player's own inventory — no kit needed.

docs.title: Creating a kit
docs.text:
Put exactly what fighters should receive into your own inventory, then:

/duels savekit <name>
Command What it does Permission /duels savekit <name> Save your current inventory as a kit duels.admin /duels loadkit <name> Load a kit into your inventory (preview/test) duels.admin /duels deletekit <name> Delete a kit duels.admin /duels setitem <kit> Set the kit's GUI icon to your held item duels.admin /kit edit <kit> Open the visual kit editor duels.kiteditor /kit save Save + exit the kit editor duels.kiteditor

docs.title: Kit characteristics (special modes)
docs.text:
/duels options <kit> (alias useoption) opens the kit options GUI, toggling characteristics:

Mode Effect SOUP Right-click mushroom soup to heal (soup.hearts-to-regen, default 3.5 hearts) UHC No natural health regeneration COMBO No delay between hits SUMO Damage only from water/lava interaction HUNGER Hunger never depletes (players will not go hungry) LOKA Damage increased by 33% ROUNDS3 Best-of-3 rounds — first to 2 round wins takes the match

docs.title: Kit permissions & arena binding
docs.text:
• Enable request.kit-selecting.use-permission, then grant duels.kits.<kitname> (or duels.kits.* for all) to gate individual kits. A kit can also require permission by itself (use-permission on the kit).
  • /duels bind <kit> opens the arena-bind GUI to restrict which arenas a kit may run on.

docs.title: Own inventory mode
docs.text:
If request.use-own-inventory.enabled is true, players can toggle Own Inventory in the duel settings instead of picking a kit. Related options:

  • drop-inventory-items: true — items drop on death and are NOT restored. Only enable for hardcore-style servers, and raise duel.teleport-delay so winners can loot.
  • use-permission: true — require duels.use.own-inventory.
  • Per-player custom kits: players with the kit editor can save personal variants that load automatically when that kit is picked.

docs.title: Kit selector GUI
docs.text: Rows and filler material: guis.kit-selector.rows (1–5, default 2). Button item per kit = its display item (/duels setitem).
